title: Cybex International Recalls Decline Free Weight Benches Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The frame of the bench can collapse forward onto the user, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: 234.

title: New Yorker Boiler Recalls Home Heating Boilers Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: The air pressure switch can fail to shut down the burners when there is a blockage in the vent system, allowing the boiler to emit excessive amounts of carbon monoxide and posing a CO poisoning hazard to the consumer. Units: About 191.

title: U.S. Boiler Recalls Home Heating Boilers Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: The air pressure switch can fail to shut down the burners when there is a blockage in the vent system, allowing the boiler to emit excessive amounts of carbon monoxide and posing a CO poisoning hazard to the consumer. Units: About 26,000 in the United States and about 310 in Canada.

title: Norwood Furniture Recalls Science Tables due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The wooden legs can split causing instability which poses an injury hazard to those using the table Units: 655.

title: Walmart Recalls Card Table and Chair Sets Due to Finger Amputation and Fall Hazards
summary: The chairs can collapse unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard and a risk of finger injury, including finger amputation. Units: About 73,400.

title: Ergotron Recalls Television Wall Mounts Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The weld between the "VESA" style mounting plate and the mounting ring can fail, allowing the monitor or TV to fall. This poses a risk of injury to bystanders. Units: About 196,200 in the United States, 60 in Canada and 21,000 in Mexico.

title: Flushmate Expands Recall of Flushmate III Pressure-Assisted Flushing System Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The system can burst at or near the vessel weld seam releasing stored pressure. This pressure can lift the tank lid and shatter the tank, posing impact and laceration hazards to consumers and property damage. Units: About 351,000 in the U.S. and about 9,400 in Canada (The Series 503 Flushmate III wa

title: Matrix Fitness Ascent Trainers and Ellipticals Recalled by Johnson Health Tech Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Moisture from user perspiration or cleaning liquids can build up in the power socket on the unit, causing a short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,800 in the U.S..

title: Pottery Barn Recalls Morovian Star Pendant Chandeliers Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The joints can fail to support the weight of the pendant causing it to fall, posing the risk of injury. Units: About 1,100.

title: Rayovac Flashlights Recalled by Spectrum Brands Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The flashlight can cause the batteries to overheat and melt the flashlight's plastic casing, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 225,000 in the United States and 7,000 in Canada.

title: Suunto Recalls Air Hoses Used With Scuba Gear Due To Drowning Hazard
summary: The high-pressure air hose may leak or rupture leading to a loss of breathing gas posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 1,300 in the U.S..

title: Baby Rattles Recalled by Midwest-CBK Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The head on the rattle can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,900.

title: Nationwide Industries Recalls Trident Pool Gate Latches Due To Failure to Secure Hazardous Areas
summary: The magnet contained in the striker portion of the latch assembly can come loose, preventing the latch from securing a gate. Units: About 2,500.

title: Playtex Recalls Pacifier Holder Clips Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pacifier holder clips can crack and a small part can break off which poses a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 1.25 million in the U.S. and 150,000 in Canada.

title: Bosch Security Systems Recalls Fire Control Panels Due to Fire Alarm Failure (Recall Alert)
summary: The notification appliance circuit module can cause the panels to fail to activate an audible or visual alarm in the event of a fire. Units: About 2,000.

title: Philips Selecon Recalls Four- and Eight-Leaf Barndoors for Rama Luminaire Stage Lights Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The heat of the stage lights can make the barndoors detach from the light and fall, posing an impact injury hazard to individuals below it. Units: About 5,500.

title: RSI Recalls Bathroom Medicine Cabinets Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at The Home Depot
summary: The mirror or its back panel can separate and fall out, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 14,000.

title: American Honda Recalls Lawnmowers Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The engine stop switch can malfunction allowing the blade to continue to rotate after the handlebar blade control lever is released, which poses a laceration hazard. Units: About 20,800 Honda brand in U.S. and 48 Columbia brand lawnmowers in U.S. and 3,000 in Canada.

title: Sears and Kmart Recall Kenmore Oscillating Fan Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: Broken motor mounts can cause the units to overheat, catch fire and ignite nearby items, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 42,500.

title: Under Armour Recalls Infant Sports Jersey Kits Due To Laceration and Choking Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The shoulder snaps on the jersey can detach, posing laceration and choking hazards. Units: About 62.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel can leak from the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 264.

title: SRAM Recalls Hydraulic Bicycle Brakes Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The brake systems can fail, posing a crash and injury hazard. Units: About 25,350.

title: Fred & Friends Recalls Infant Pacifiers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pacifiers fail to meet federal safety standards. The beard on the Artiste and the knob on the Volume pacifiers can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. In addition, the ventilation holes on the Volume and Panic pacifier guards are too small. Units: About 183,000 in the United State

title: Gree Expands Dehumidifier Recall to Include GE Brand Dehumidifiers Due to Serious Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The dehumidifiers can overheat, smoke and catch fire, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 350,000 in the United States and 2,700 in Canada (Gree previously recalled 2.2 million dehumidifiers under 12 other brand names in September 2013).

title: Strollers Recalled by Britax Due to Partial Fingertip Amputation Hazard
summary: The hinge on the stroller's folding mechanism can partially amputate consumers' fingertips, break their fingers or cause severe lacerations, among other injuries, when they press the release button while pulling on the release strap. Units: About 216,000 in the United States and 8,800 in Canada.

title: West Marine Recalls Folding Bicycles; Frames Can Break Causing Riders to Fall
summary: The bicycle's frame can break during use, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 4,600.

title: IKEA Expands Recall of Junior Beds that Pose Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal rod connecting the guard rail to the bed frame can break in use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 3,500 (22,000 units were previously recalled for repair in August 2013).

title: Bodum USA Recalls Coffee Presses Sold Exclusively at Starbucks Due to Laceration and Burn Hazards
summary: The glass carafe can fall out of the metal frame and plastic base of the coffee press and break or shatter, posing laceration and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 28,000.

title: Horizon Hobby Recalls Remote Controlled Model Helicopters Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The tail rotor grip used for securing the tail rotor blade to the tail rotor hub can separate and release from the helicopter, posing a risk of a crash and injury hazard. Units: About 1980 in the U.S. and 200 in Canada.

title: Reebok-CCM Recalls Senior Hockey Elbow Pads Due to Risk of Elbow Injury
summary: The molded foam padding inside the elbow pads can become cracked, fractured or split, which poses a risk of injury to the elbow. Units: About 2,100 in the United States and 1,600 in Canada.

title: System Sensor Recalls Reflected Beam Smoke Detectors Due To Failure to Alert Consumers in a Fire (Recall Alert)
summary: When used with certain power supplies, the reflected beam smoke detectors can fail to send a signal to the fire alarm control panel that sounds the alarm and fail to alert occupants of a fire. Units: About 610.
